issues.title: [Audit A0] Re-baseline the upstream reference to MESA release 26.4.1
[Audit A2] Upstream-history end-to-end harness and stored reference histories
[Audit A4] Governance: rules for expected values, pass criteria and the meaning of "green"
[Audit C12] History and profile output with upstream column definitions
[Audit C14] Numerics policy: strict (hardware-independent) and fast modes from one Rust source
[Audit E2] Generated progress dashboard in README and docs: port coverage by module, verification status, test coverage, issues and PRs
[Audit A1] Correct public claims, scorecards and synthetic figures
[Audit A3] CI that runs real campaigns, and a declared-known-gaps mechanism
[Audit A5] Benchmark honesty and provenance
[Audit A6] Profile a real evolution and measure what fast math, batching and waste removal each buy
[Audit B1] Fail loudly on unsupported controls, missing data and discarded errors
[Audit B2] Move test-case code out of the library and delete fabricated behaviour
[Audit B3] Defaults parity with upstream `*.defaults`
[Audit B4] Error type, telemetry, retry-proof counters, checkpoints, and removal of whole-model clones
[Audit B5] Energy accounting as upstream does it
[Audit C1] Newton iteration control and retry semantics (`star_solver.f90`, `evolve.f90`)
[Audit C2] Mesh planner (`mesh_plan.f90`, `mesh_functions.f90`, `adjust_mesh*.f90`)
[Audit C3] Relaxation machinery and initial-model construction (`relax.f90`, `create_initial_model.f90`, `init_model.f90`)
[Audit C4] Convective boundaries and mixing: predictive mixing, premixing, overshoot, composition-gradient smoothing
[Audit C5] Element diffusion and phase separation
[Audit C6] Time-dependent convection state handling and turbulence wiring
[Audit C7] Rotation, angular momentum transport and rotational mixing
[Audit C8] Winds, mass change and stop conditions
[Audit C9] Binary step structure, orbital integrator and implicit mass transfer
[Audit C10] Microphysics control coverage and gaps (EOS, opacity, nets and rates, atmospheres, neutrinos)
[Audit C11] Pulsation, asteroseismology and optimizers
[Audit C13] Data pipeline provenance and runtime caches
[Audit C15] JAX contract: derived, differentiable and batched; validated against Rust strict mode
[Audit] Level-2 exact-hex probes for the remaining math and auto_diff values
[Audit C17] Port the remaining upstream per-case extras to test-side hooks
[JAX] Rust-versus-JAX consistency tests expected to fail while the JAX engine is frozen
[Audit C8/C12] Wire remaining photo/log I/O and test-harness driver controls
[Audit] Level-2 module-hex probe wiring for interp_1d, interp_2d, mtx and num
[Audit D1] Port GYRE (pulsation code bundled with MESA)
[Audit D2] Port ADIPLS (adiabatic pulsation code bundled with MESA)
[Audit D3] Port STELLA (radiative-transfer code bundled with MESA), after all test-suite cases pass
[Audit E1] Plotting as we go: a pgstar and pgbinary replacement built on history and profile output
[Audit E2] Generated progress dashboard in README and docs: port coverage by module, verification status, test coverage, issues and PRs
